title: 第十五章 谢苍荣的大脑第十六章 他喜欢有用的
slug: 一统天下后方知此世有仙
content_zh:
学好数理化，走遍天下都不怕。
谢苍荣相信这是对的，但是很遗憾，虽说打遍了天下，可谢苍荣的数理化学得不是很理想。
重生在了落后的时代，却没能力手搓坦克大炮，引领工业革命。谢苍荣知道未来科学发展的轮廓，但是光知道是没有用的，科学需要脚踏实地的发展，需要一步步实践，需要无数知识的积淀，而这些东西显然学历史的谢苍荣没有。
况且时间紧迫，他也没精力，没时间去研究这些。
不过，这也无妨，一统天下从来不是靠个人之力来完成的。
有人负责运筹帷幄，有人负责血战沙场，有人负责安邦治民……各个方面都需要形形色色的人才。
谢苍荣是领袖，是政治家，是战略家，是谈判家，并不一定非要成为科学家，他只需要掌握好大方向就行。
他不精通于科学研究，有人精通就可以了。
比如说，宫巧。
铁匠家的女儿，姑娘聪慧的紧，动手能力也强，思维跳脱，天马行空，尤擅长发明创造。她从小便与谢苍荣相识，被他发掘了才华，进行光源氏计划养成。
谢苍荣有另一个时代的带来的开阔视野，虽说不精于数理化，但是好歹也知道些基础知识，这已经远远超过这个时代的科技水平了。
他是行动的矮子，但也是言语上的巨人。即便搓不出火箭大炮，但是领着宫巧入门，为她指明发展方向，排除她的错误，让她少走些弯路，还是可以做到的。
起事之后，谢苍荣很重视攀科技树，特地分配资源为宫巧打造了研究班底和工匠团队。
在谢苍荣的支持下，火铳和大炮第一次在这个时代被创造出来，一步步发展改善，大大加强了军队的战斗能力，蒸汽机得以创制。除此之外，航运、农业、工造、医疗……等等诸多方面，都有所进步。
虽说科学技术没有像坐火箭一般跨越式发展，但也在一步一步脚踏实地地前行。
科学家是高地，科学家是未来，科学家是长期回报。谢苍荣鲸吞天下，宫巧及其团队在背后发挥的隐形作用也不可忽视。
经过无数实验积累和技术钻研，宫巧的专业造诣已经超越谢苍荣了。单单在学术科学发展方面，谢苍荣除了给她指明宏观发展方向之外，已经没什么可以教她的了。
研究，实验，学习……这永远都不会错。
谢苍荣相信他的‘大脑’，即便是出现了超出认知的修士，宫巧依旧是他手中极为重要的一张牌。
某种意义上讲，修炼便是另外的一门科学。发展修仙业，就是发展另一门科学。他要给宫巧创造条件，去解析修士一方的力量，铸就法宝，学习复制，建立起学说理论体系，用国家的力量来修行，带动他的大夏前行发展。

……
谈及正事，宫巧也神情一肃，面无表情地摇摇头：“不行。”
“此物已然损坏，我感应不到丝毫特异，无从研究。”
“仅知铸造其柄的木材极为不凡，强度胜过铜铁，却兼具韧性与延展性，我朝境内从未见过此类木材。”她严谨地陈述着发现，没了刚刚那般阴阳怪气的态度。
“这样啊……”
谢苍荣微微颔首，这结果并不意外。
将玩坏的玩具丢给宫巧，指望她研究出什么，属实是强人所难了。
失误便是失误了，也没什么好可惜的，谢苍荣站起身来，随意拈起一撮粟米，撒入池中，笑道：“无妨，以后总归还有机会。”
“嗯……”
content_en:
If you learn mathematics, physics and chemistry well, you will not be afraid of traveling all over the world.
Xie Cangrong believes that this is right, but unfortunately, although he has conquered the world, Xie Cangrong's mathematics, physics and chemistry are not very good.
He was reborn in a backward era, but he was unable to rub tanks and cannons with his hands and lead the industrial revolution. Xie Cangrong knows the outline of future scientific development, but it is useless to know it alone. Science requires down-to-earth development, step-by-step practice, and the accumulation of countless knowledge, and Xie Cangrong, who studies history, obviously does not have these things.
Besides, time was tight and he didn't have the energy to study these things.
However, it doesn't matter. Unification of the world is never accomplished by one's own efforts.
Some people are responsible for strategizing, some are responsible for bloody battles on the battlefield, and some are responsible for maintaining peace and order for the people... All kinds of talents are needed in all aspects.
Xie Cangrong is a leader, a politician, a strategist, and a negotiator. He does not necessarily have to be a scientist. He just needs to grasp the general direction.
He is not proficient in scientific research. Someone who is proficient in it will be fine.
For example, Gong Qiao.
The daughter of a blacksmith, the girl is very smart, has strong hands-on ability, has unconventional thinking, and is especially good at inventions and creations. She had known Xie Cangrong since she was a child, and he discovered her talent and developed her under the Guangyuan clan plan.
Xie Cangrong has a broad vision brought by another era. Although he is not good at mathematics, physics and chemistry, he still knows some basic knowledge, which is far beyond the technological level of this era.
He is a dwarf in action, but also a giant in words. Even if you can't make a rocket cannon, you can still lead Gong Qiao to get started, point out the direction of her development, eliminate her mistakes, and save her from detours.
After the incident, Xie Cangrong attached great importance to climbing the technological tree and specially allocated resources to build a research team and craftsman team for Gong Qiao.
With the support of Xie Cangrong, firecrackers and cannons were created for the first time in this era. They were developed and improved step by step, greatly strengthening the army's combat capabilities, and the steam engine was created. In addition, progress has been made in shipping, agriculture, manufacturing, medical care, and many other aspects.
Although science and technology have not developed by leaps and bounds like a rocket, they are also moving forward step by step.
Scientists are the high ground, scientists are the future, and scientists are the long-term rewards. Xie Cangrong swallows the whole world, and the invisible role played by Gong Qiao and his team behind the scenes cannot be ignored.
After countless experiments and technical research, Gong Qiao's professional attainments have surpassed Xie Cangrong's. In terms of academic and scientific development alone, Xie Cangrong had nothing to teach her except pointing out the macro development direction.
Research, experiment, learn...you can never go wrong with this.
Xie Cangrong believed in his 'brain'. Even if there were monks beyond his cognition, Gong Qiao was still an extremely important card in his hand.
In a sense, cultivation is another science. To develop the industry of cultivating immortals is to develop another science. He wanted to create conditions for Gong Qiao to analyze the power of the monks, forge magic weapons, learn to copy, establish a theoretical system, use the power of the country to practice, and drive his development forward in Daxia.
…
When it came to business, Gong Qiao also looked solemn and shook his head expressionlessly: "No."
"This object has been damaged. I can't sense anything special at all, so I can't study it."
"I only know that the wood used to cast the handle is extremely extraordinary. It is stronger than copper and iron, but has both toughness and ductility. I have never seen this kind of wood in our country." She stated her discovery rigorously, without the yin and yang attitude just now.
"That's it..."
Xie Cangrong nodded slightly, this result was not surprising.
Throwing a broken toy to Gong Qiao and expecting her to research anything is really too much.
A mistake is a mistake, and there is nothing to regret. Xie Cangrong stood up, randomly picked up a handful of corn, threw it into the pond, and smiled.He said: "It doesn't matter, there will always be opportunities in the future."
"Well..."
